behaviourScope.identity: Reuse existing twelve resident IDs, never human presence or source authors. Existing server-controlled restroom routine remains separate.
behaviourScope.position: Canonical great-circle tours, independent of frame rate or source additions/removals. New real sculpture geometry can select a safe fallback position; this exceptional change can reposition a figure.
behaviourScope.attention: After two-second settle, a roughly seven-second eased initial window; later eight seconds in thirty with stable source/group phase. It changes gaze and upper-body response while walking remains grounded.
behaviourScope.conversation: Actual nearby partners, mutual orientation and 3.2-second role turns. A wordless cue is an NPC animation, not a generated message or new sound.
behaviourScope.rendering: Final cue uses actual animated head plus 0.22m, width0.62m. Its diagnostic is the actual sprite world point. Shared work/idle layers yield to walking and conversations.

limits: Authored tours and gestures are a small behaviour system, not free-form AI conversation or simulated needs.
Only mutual nearby partners converse; people and geometry can obscure a particular frame. A bounded visible capture is not universal visibility proof.
Optional 2D/2.5D views were not extended or rerun in this revision. Existing coastal residents retain their optional-contract default behaviour.
Native audio/quiet lifecycle checks do not establish artistic sound quality.

rollback.data: Keep current database, never restore an old database for appearance.
